title: He longed to be at home and lay his head on his mother’s lap.
html_source: Stephen was homesick, and hearing all the other boys talk about their parents made Stephen miss his own. Although his relationship with his family isn’t as strong as the other boy’s relationships with theirs, he just wants to be at home, where he can feel comfortable in a familiar environment. Or, perhaps he is secretly a mama’s boy?
